'''Huttbreaker's compound''' was the residence of [[Huttbreaker]] and her [[Huttbreaker's crew|crew]] during the [[Third Galactic War|third conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />

The compound was the location of the [[Mek-Sha Tradehouse]].<ref name="TOR:TR">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Tradehouse Requisitions|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
